consent.signInBody: Sign in with the account you want to connect Claude to. You'll come back here to confirm.

errors.missing-client: The link doesn't say which app wants to connect. Add the connector in Claude again.
errors.unknown-client: We don't know this app. Add the connector in Claude again.
errors.bad-redirect: The address Claude wants to return to doesn't match. Add the connector in Claude again.
errors.bad-request: The connection request isn't valid. Try again in Claude.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

consent.title: Allow access?
consent.lead: {app} will work with your zicha.travel account. It can see and change only what you can on the web.
consent.writeHint: It can add and change expenses for you, confirm them, take beds and car seats, edit the shopping list and vote.
consent.readHint: It sees your chatas, expenses, balances and who sleeps where. It changes nothing.
consent.privacy: Whatever Claude reads through the connector goes to Anthropic, including the names and amounts of other people on your trips. You can disconnect at any time on the Connect Claude page.

page.metaDescription: Connect Claude to your zicha.travel account.
page.title: Connect Claude
page.intro: Connect Claude to your account and ask it about your trips: who owes whom, where you sleep, who rides in which car, what's on the shopping list. It can also add an expense or take a car seat for you. It sees and does only what you can on the web.
page.signedOut: Sign in first. A connection belongs to your account.
page.claudeAiTitle: Claude on the web, mobile and desktop
page.claudeAiSteps: In Claude, open Settings, then Connectors, and Add custom connector. Paste this address and confirm. Claude sends you here to allow the connection.
page.claudeCodeSteps: Run this command, then type /mcp in Claude Code and sign in.
page.empty: Nothing yet. Once you connect Claude, it shows up here.
page.loadFailed: Couldn't load your connections. Try reloading the page.
page.privacy: Whatever Claude reads goes to Anthropic, including the names and amounts of other people on your trips. Anthropic works for you here, not for us, so think about what you ask it.
